stories.title: Wrexham to Bidston trains disrupted until 9am after engineering works overrun
stories.summary: Trains between Wrexham Central and Bidston, serving Shotton, Hawarden and Buckley, may be delayed or cancelled until 9am on Thursday after engineering works were not finished on time. stories.title: Senedd backs cross-party calls to review Welsh funding formula
stories.summary: Senedd Members have backed calls to review Wales’ funding formula to increase fairness and transparency in how the nation is financed. stories.title: School leaders’ union and Welsh Government agree 14 working days of intensive talks over pay and funding
stories.summary: School leaders’ union NAHT Cymru and the Welsh Government have agreed to 14 working days of intensive negotiations to try to settle a dispute over pay, workload and school funding. stories.title: One in three Flintshire children live in income deprivation, and that is among the lowest rates in Wales
stories.summary: About one in three children in Flintshire were living in income deprivation in 2024, according to Welsh Government figures. stories.title: Ambulance handover delays still Wales’ “most significant” challenge despite progress, says watchdog
stories.summary: Delayed patient handovers remain the most significant challenge facing the Welsh Ambulance Service despite wider improvements made within the Trust.
